product.name: Monoprice SuperSpeed 7-Port USB-C Hub Gray
product.description: Expand your laptop's USB capabilities by adding seven SuperSpeed USB 3.0 ports. Designed to connect to a laptop or PC with a USB‑C® port, this hub allows you to connect external hard drives, flash drives, mobile devices, USB display adapters, and more. While it gets all the power it needs from the USB bus, it also features a DC power jack for use with an optional AC power adapter (not included). Capable of data transfer speeds up to 5Gbps, this hub is also backwards compatible with USB 2.0 and 1.1 devices.
